source_code_findings.concrete_steel_rebar_grade_properties_pr: osdagbridge local database. These three tables (Concrete_Grade_Properties [16 rows], Rebar_Grade_Properties [7 rows], Steel_Grade_Properties [28 rows]) exist exclusively in osdagbridge local database and do NOT exist in osdag_core.

path_resolution.osdagbridge: Uses Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'data' / 'ResourceFiles' / 'Intg_osdag.sqlite' or importlib.resources.files('osdagbridge.core.data.ResourceFiles').joinpath('Intg_osdag.sqlite'), resolving to local package resource directory.

data_initialization_copy_seed_overwrite.osdagbridge.desktop.__main__.create_sqli: Checks if sqlite exists; if missing or 0-byte or mtime < sql mtime, builds/updates from Intg_osdag.sql.
data_initialization_copy_seed_overwrite.osdagbridge.desktop.__main__.ensure_osda: Checks if osdag_core sqlite is missing, 0 bytes, or has no tables; if so, populates from osdag_core's Intg_osdag.sql.

source_code_findings.can_application_accidentally_read_wrong_: No. PlateGirderBridge and OsdagBridge core utilities hardcode their path specifically to the local repository ResourceFiles directory (_DB_PATH). osdag_core uses importlib.resources anchored to the osdag_core namespace in site-packages. The namespaces and paths are completely isolated.
